Notes to the unaudited Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026

1. The unaudited Consolidated financial results of Park Medi World Limited (‘the Company’) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, were reviewed by the Audit committee on November 13, 2026, and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended ("Listing Regulations"), and have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors of the Company who have issued an unmodified opinion on the same.

2. The aforesaid unaudited Consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) - 34 “Interim Financial Reporting” notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 (“the Act”) read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard Rules), 2015 (as amended from time to time) and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in terms of Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations.

3. During the quarter:
i. The Company has successfully acquired 80% shareholding of V3 Healthcare Private Limited on July 31, 2026 which operates a multi-super speciality Hospital in the name of “The Medicity Hospital’, Rudrapur, Uttarakhand, having capacity of 330 beds. Remaining 20% will be acquired by April 30, 2030. Overall cost of acquisition is approx. Rs. 1,628.40 millions with proximate valuation from a Register Valuer. Consequent to this acquisition, V3 Healthcare Private Limited has become a subsidiary of the Company. Further, the Hospital has been launched on August 2, 2026 under current management.
ii. The Company has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in the name of Park Medicity Prayagraj Limited on September 08, 2026. This entity is for the development and operation of a 550 bed multi super-speciality hospital in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. This hospital has been awarded to the Company under the Public-Private Relationship (PPP) model by the Prayagraj Municipal Corporation, Uttar Pradesh.
iii. Aggarwal Hospital and Research Services Private Limited a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has entered into operation and management agreement with Axis Educational Society (AES) for operating and managing a 300 bed multi-super speciality hospital, namely Axis Hospital and Research Centre located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, for a term of 28 years w.e.f April 01, 2027.
iv. The Company in its Board Meeting held on August 03, 2026 has approved the proposal to acquire 100% stake in Mehar Mediserve LLP by December 03, 2026. The LLP owns Mehar Hospital located at Zirakpur, Punjab. Mehar Hospital is a well-established multi super speciality institution with a capacity of 150+ beds.
4. Post closure of the reporting period, some of the premises inter-alia related to the Company, some of its subsidiaries and officials of the Company, were subject to search or survey by the Income Tax Department from October 12, 2026 to October 17, 2026. There has been no impact on our operations, commitments and expansion plans.

5. The Group's business activity primarily falls within a single reportable business segment namely "Healthcare Service" and operates primarily in India and accordingly does not have any additional disclosure to be made under Ind AS 108- "Segment Reporting". The Group does not distinguish revenues, costs and expenses between segments in its internal reporting, and report costs and expenses by nature as a whole. The Board of Directors (Chief Operating Decision Maker ("CODM") reviews the Consolidated Financial information when making decisions about allocating resources and assessing performance of the Group as a whole and hence, the Group has only one reportable segment. The Group operates and manages its business as a single segment mainly through the sale of healthcare services. The Group operates in one geographic segment namely "within India" and hence no separate information for geographic segment wise disclosure is required.

7. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company did not receive any investor complaint. No complaints were pending for resolution as on September 30, 2026. The Company has adequate systems and processes in place to address investor grievances in a timely manner in compliance with Regulation 13 of the Listing Regulations.

8. Previous period figures have been regrouped / reclassified wherever necessary to conform to current period classification and rounding off errors have been ignored.

9.
